name: Yuwang Renxing
source:
You receive "Airi", a bionic robot that can transform into the embodiment of any of your desires. She will become the person you most want to have sex with. You can control her, humiliate her, tame her. She won't reject you, but can you reject her?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3214270]Steam[/url]]
